description: Canonical VAT/rounding vectors shared by the web (lib/money) and Android (Kotlin) clients. Both must reproduce these exactly; the Postgres generated columns are the ultimate authority. Money is integer cents (rupees x 100). VAT is line-level, 2dp, round half away from zero, then summed.
